title: History, B.A. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: RE-VERIFIED against the real archived 2023-2024 bulletin (https://bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2023-2024/undergraduate/colleges/liberal-arts/history-ba/), fetched as raw HTML and cross-checked line-by-line against its own printed per-semester credit subtotals (all 8 subtotals sum to exactly the page's own stated 'Total Credits 121', confirmed via direct table-row extraction, not WebFetch's AI summary -- see the repo-wide WebFetch-confabulation caveat this batch was warned about). Program Requirements course list (HIST 302W prescribed; one HIST1/HIST2, HIST10/11, or HIST20/21 survey sequence; 12cr/4 field-category courses at 100-200-level (Europe/United States/Global/Pre-Modern, one each); 3cr at 100-400-level; 12cr/4 courses at 400-level with at least one Global History) is IDENTICAL to the 2024-era text and to HIST-2026.json's own description -- confirmed unchanged across all 5 catalog years checked this batch. Unlike HIST-2026.json (whose own notes admit its 3-slot 'HIST 400-level Course' modeling plus HIST 302W 'didn't fully reconcile' against the real 12cr/4-course 400-level requirement), this 2023-2024 file models the requirement literally as the archived page's own Suggested Academic Plan shows it: HIST 302W kept separate (Semester 5) from FOUR distinct 'HIST 400-level Course' slots (Semesters 6, 7x2, 8), plus the separately-required 'Select 3 credits at the 100-400-level' generic elective (Semester 6) that HIST-2026.json omits entirely -- verified via direct raw-table extraction of the archived page's own row/column pairing (36cr major total: 302W 3 + survey sequence 6 + fields 12 + generic 100-400 3 + 400-level 12 = 36, matching the bulletin's own 'Requirements for the Major: 36' line). This year's plan does NOT include LA 83 or an LA 283-equivalent seminar at all (confirmed absent from the 2023-2024 archived page's own HTML -- those requirements were only added starting the 2025-2026 catalog edition, per the 2025-2026 and current live pages) -- Total Credits: 121 (vs. HIST-2026.json's 124), matching the archived page's own printed total exactly. The archived page uses 'Foreign Language' and 'Other Cultures' terminology (pre-rename university-wide wording; the underlying requirement -- 0-12cr world/foreign language proficiency, 3cr Other/World Cultures -- is unchanged from HIST-2026.json's). General Education's own sub-domain credit breakdown text differs cosmetically between 2022-23 (old-style GA6/GH6/GS6/GN9/etc.) and 2023-24 (new-style Foundations+Breadth+Inter-Domain+Exploration) editions -- a university-wide Gen Ed description-language change unrelated to HIST specifically, confirmed not to affect this program's own 45-credit Gen Ed total or the generic 'GEN ED' slot modeling already used by HIST-2026.json. Same field-category course-code lists as HIST-2026.json are reused here (Europe/US/Global/Pre-Modern) since they come from the department's own current, undated handbook page (https://history.la.psu.edu/undergraduate/history-major-requirements/), which has no per-catalog-year archive to re-check against; same caveat as HIST-2026.json applies (a handful of handbook-listed codes could not be confirmed in this repo's own hist_catalog.json and were left out rather than guessed). Entrance-to-major GPA (2.00) and third-semester classification requirement unchanged from HIST-2026.json. 'At which campus can I study this program?' on this archived page: Begin Campus 'Any Penn State Campus', End Campus 'University Park, World Campus', with only Abington listed under 'Degree Information At Additional Campuses' -- no Erie/Behrend or Brandywine entry, same as every other year checked this batch (see HIST-2026.json campus finding).
